title: Website development in Prescott, AZ | Creosote Labs
meta_description: Websites, customer portals, and web applications for Prescott businesses. Fixed-price projects quoted after a scoping call, hosting and handover included.
h1: Website and web application development in Prescott
intro: Hotels, restaurants, tour operators, and retail stores in Prescott depend on a website that answers questions and takes bookings. Trades, medical practices, and professional firms in town often run a site built years ago on Wix, Squarespace, or WordPress, with contact forms that land in an inbox and quote requests handled by phone. Booking, intake, and quoting are the points where a website can do more of the work.

Creosote Labs builds marketing websites, customer portals, and web applications for businesses in Prescott and across Northern Arizona. A marketing site states services, pricing, and a way to book or contact the business. A customer-facing tool handles quote requests, reservations, or intake forms directly. Every project includes hosting setup, domain configuration, and handover with documentation, and is quoted at a fixed price after a scoping call.
projects: A marketing website for a landscaping company with a service list, pricing ranges, and a quote request form that reaches the estimator.
An online booking page for a tour operator that checks availability, collects waivers, and sends confirmation emails.
A patient intake portal for a chiropractic office that replaces paper forms in the waiting room.
A menu and reservation site for a downtown Prescott restaurant that updates from a single spreadsheet.
A customer portal for a property management company where tenants submit maintenance requests and owners view monthly statements.

faqs.q: How is a website project priced?
faqs.a: Projects are quoted after a scoping call at a fixed price. There is no hourly billing, and hosting setup and domain configuration are included in the quote.

faqs.q: What does a Prescott business need to provide for a website project?
faqs.a: The business provides access to the current domain registrar, the text and photos the site should carry, and a decision on which actions the site should handle, such as booking or quote requests. We supply the rest.

faqs.q: Who maintains the site after handover?
faqs.a: The business maintains it. Every project ends with documentation for updating content, and the site is built so staff can make routine changes without a developer.
